Sanford Shapes Skateboards - Handcrafted Decks for Passionate Riders

Sanford Shapes Skateboards offers high-quality, handcrafted skateboards designed for skaters who demand precision, durability, and style. Unlike mass-produced boards with screen-printed graphics, each Sanford Shapes skateboard is handcrafted in San Diego, California, using only natural woods. Our unique designs showcase the natural beauty of different wood types, with each color and pattern representing a distinct piece of wood, not paint.

Why Promote Sanford Shapes Skateboards?

  1. Unique, Artisanal Design: Unlike mass-produced boards, each Sanford Shapes skateboard is a one-of-a-kind piece of art, crafted in San Diego using only natural woods. Our designs are made by combining different wood types, not screen printing, so each color and pattern is naturally embedded, making every board truly unique.
  2. Sustainable Craftsmanship: We’re committed to sustainability. By choosing natural materials and avoiding toxic finishes, we reduce our environmental impact while offering riders a premium, eco-friendly option.
  3. High Quality & Durability: Sanford Shapes decks are built to last, crafted with precision to ensure strength and durability, perfect for skaters who demand top performance and value in their gear.
  4. Authentic Skateboarding Culture: As a brand born from passion, Sanford Shapes embodies the authenticity of the skateboarding lifestyle, appealing to riders who appreciate artistry and individuality.
  5. Generous Commission Rates: Affiliates can earn competitive commissions on each sale, with higher payouts for promoting a premium, unique product that resonates with discerning skaters.
  6. Growing Community & Social Reach: Join a brand that’s gaining momentum and building a loyal following in the skate community. Be part of our journey as we make an impact in skate culture.
  7. Marketing Support & Exclusive Perks: We support our affiliates with marketing resources, early access to new designs, and exclusive discounts to help you succeed in your promotions.

With Sanford Shapes, affiliates get to represent a high-quality, handcrafted brand that celebrates creativity, sustainability, and individuality in skateboarding.

Join the Sanford Shapes Affiliate Program

As a Sanford Shapes affiliate, you’ll have the opportunity to earn commissions by promoting a brand that values craftsmanship and creativity. We provide marketing assets, frequent updates, and the support you need to succeed.

We’re looking for passionate skaters, influencers, and creators to help spread the word. Join us to represent a brand that celebrates individuality and the artistry of skateboarding!

Visit sanfordshapes.com and check us out on social media @sanfordshapes.
